description: Verify that TCP in ESTABLISHED returns ACK with proper SEQ/ACK numbers after receiving a segment with OTW SEQ or unacceptable ACK (RFC 793 §3.4 p37)
approach:
[Objective]
In ESTABLISHED, an OTW-SEQ or unacceptable-ACK segment must trigger a corrective ACK announcing the SEQ DUT actually expects — same as FLAGS_INVALID_08 but stated from §3.4's perspective.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: data with OTW SEQ.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: ACK with proper SEQ.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted corrective ACK observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_otw_seq_ack — no DUT ACK to OTW-SEQ data

verdicts.Pass: DUT corrective-acked OTW-SEQ in EST — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK within listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_otw_seq_ack: No DUT ACK to OTW-SEQ data
